suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific inflammatory cardiac complication. Apply only to the documented myocarditis phenotype within the broader cardiac-inflammatory identity and separately documented arrhythmia. Do not generalize to every inflammatory cardiac diagnosis. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Pericarditis / Endocarditis / Myocarditis matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Cardiac Arrhythmias (Atrial Fibrillation, Tachycardia) with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors

Resolution of the publication guard: Apply only to the documented myocarditis phenotype within the broader cardiac-inflammatory identity and separately documented arrhythmia. Do not generalize to every inflammatory cardiac diagnosis.
